directions.argument: Edit the signal on the signal: one sovereign stage, direct overlays, compact inspector.
directions.composition: Top transport and scope, dominant waveform stage, slim preset strip, 320px right inspector.
directions.interaction: Overview and Focus modes; drag playhead, selection, cutoffs, thresholds, and radial origin directly on the artifact.
directions.visualLanguage: Near-black calibrated instrument, quiet hairlines, luminance-led hierarchy, one signal accent and semantic state colors.
directions.signature: Signal overlays are both measurement and control, so advanced parameters remain visibly tethered to their effect.
directions.responsiveScrollModel: No-scroll desktop workbench; bounded inspector first, stage second on narrow screens.
directions.assetPlan: Deterministic generated audio plus local user file; no decorative imagery.
directions.primaryRisk: Dense overlays could become illegible; progressive disclosure and direct-manipulation affordances must stay disciplined.

directions.argument: Make renderer parity the product: four synchronized engines shown at once.
directions.composition: Left source/analysis rail, 2x2 phase-locked renderer matrix, shared bottom timeline.
directions.interaction: Scrubbing or changing data updates every tile; selecting one tile expands it for deeper control.
directions.visualLanguage: Lab comparison grid with strict shared axes and capability annotations.
directions.signature: One crosshair and time/frequency cursor travels across every engine for like-for-like comparison.
directions.responsiveScrollModel: Matrix collapses to a selected renderer plus swipeable engine tabs on narrow screens.
directions.assetPlan: Same deterministic signal frame for every renderer.
directions.primaryRisk: Comparison chrome competes with creative tuning and makes the main waveform feel like a test fixture.

directions.argument: Expose customization as routing: sources and analysis bands patch into visual parameters.
directions.composition: Source nodes left, large visual center, modulation/parameter graph right, transport below.
directions.interaction: Drag level, bands, peaks, or time into color, scale, glow, rotation, and geometry ports.
directions.visualLanguage: Diagrammatic patch cords and compact node labels over a restrained stage.
directions.signature: Every audio-to-visual mapping is visible as a patch, making reactive behavior explicit and remixable.
directions.responsiveScrollModel: Separate Patch and Preview modes on narrow screens.
directions.assetPlan: Real analysis channels and preset patches; no fake nodes.
directions.primaryRisk: Learned node interaction delays the common task and creates a second product before core controls are proven.

selection.reason: It maps the proven folders playground structure onto audio without hiding the artifact, supports all required states, and leaves renderer comparison as Overview rather than making comparison chrome sovereign.
selection.whyNotHybrid: Adding the matrix or patch graph to the primary screen would dilute the direct signal-editing thesis. Their best ideas can appear later as bounded modes, not as the default composition.
selection.blindReadRisk: A dense control panel can obscure the primary route, and visual mode can be confused with rendering engine.
selection.acceptedRepair: Render Visual mode and Rendering engine as distinct labeled control rows; reinforce Play -> adjust on the signal -> Copy code as the primary route.
